title: Quantum Dilogarithm as Localized Torsion Volume
html:
Corollary. Quantum Dilogarithm as Localized Torsion Volume

In the archimedean realisation, the transient trace contribution \mathrm{tr}_{\mathrm{trans}}(\varrho, p_i) from the topological decomposition of mass identically evaluates to the quantum dilogarithm \Phi_q(z_i). Here, z_i denotes the exact spectral coordinate of p_i within the Briggs–Klein chart (Briggs–Klein chart).
